newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks hardly react to U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks hardly react to U.S. data.

text.p: French shares hardly reacted to the U.S. durable goods and jobless claims numbers and remained around the 2,300 level, dealers said.
Wall Street was seen opening mixed to higher on the data after Thursday's gains.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 0.23 points or 0.01 percent at 2,304.44 at 1346 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,308 from 2,304 on Thursday's close.

* Groups representing the Bollore family breached the threshold of two thirds of voting rights in conglomerate Bollore Technologies. The family now owns 4,608,962 voting rights, or 66.78 percent of the total.
* Canal Plus welcomes Spanish soccer broadcast deal reached between three Spanish companies, including the Sogecable holding company in which it owns 25 percent.
